_criterion: A mechanism field scored 2 by the annotation instrument is set to 0 in the validity layer when an independent record shows the written argument for that mechanism is invalid as written: an explicit counterexample to a lemma it relies on, or a recorded fatal invalid step in that mechanism by the public verifier or our gate. The criterion is applied to every retained text carrying the same defect, not only to final files. S_written (instrument) and S_valid (after these entries) are both released; the paper's trajectory counts use S_valid and report S_written alongside.
